versions.changelog:
Initial release of ticket-monitor.

- Real-time monitoring of ticket availability and sold-out status for Damai events.
- Alerts on ticket changes (restock, return, sold out) via terminal/log, Webhook (Server酱, WeCom, Dingtalk, generic), or Windows desktop notification.
- Simple Node.js implementation with zero third-party dependencies.
- Flexible configuration for polling interval, notification methods, and authentication via browser cookie.
- Offers monitoring by itemId or URL, with support for both summary and raw data output.
